text:
maria.ops: quick heads up — found partner ingestion logs that include GCS object names with ciphertext that look like KMS-wrapped backups referencing our wrap key. need rotation + audit logging enabled ASAP. sample below

maria.ops: ```
object: gs://partner-archive/backups/2026-03-23/backup-20260323.tar.gz.enc
metadata: {"kmsKeyName":"projects/redwood-ops/locations/global/keyRings/backups/cryptoKeys/wrap-key","cipherPrefix":"CiQA..."}
```

alex.sre: ack. do we know if Data Access audit logs were on for that keyring?

maria.ops: checked console — admin logs were on but Data Access for KMS was NOT enabled for backups keyRing (looks like missed onboarding step last year).

security-bot: ALERT: KMS_CIPHER_DETECTION - 2 objects matched known-wrap-key pattern. Created incident 2026-03-23-87.

tim.sec: ok. high level plan: 1) create new wrapping key (new-key-v2) 2) enable Data Access audit logs for that keyRing 3) restrict IAM on new key, grant only rewrap service account + vault 4) update Vault wrapping config to use new-key-v2 and deploy canary 5) run controlled rewrap of partner/backups + rotate related service accounts 6) retire/disable old key after verification.

samira.eng: I can create the new key + rewrap script. recommend a staged rewrap (one bucket canary -> 10% -> full). also we should limit the new key IAM to a single principal: `svc-rewrap@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com` plus vault service account.

alex.sre: on the Vault side we'll need to update transit/wrapping config. sample change: `vault write sys/wrapping/config wrap_key="projects/.../cryptoKeys/new-key-v2"` (pseudocode). We'll do a canary deploy to the vault-private pool first.

oncall: available for maintenance window 10:30-11:30 PST. prefer short rewrap during that window.

maria.ops: proposed timeline: create key + enable audit (now, target +20m), IAM lockdown (10m), vault config + canary (30m), rewrap canary in window (10:30), follow-on full rewrap if canary good (30-60m), disable old key + post-checks (1h).

tim.sec: while doing this, I'll run immediate IAM/log triage to check who accessed the old key in last 30 days. run this command:

```
# list principals that used the keyring in the last 30d
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_key_ring" protoPayload.methodName:"Encrypt" AND resource.labels.key_ring_name:backups' --freshness=30d --format='value(protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail)' | sort | uniq -c
```

samira.eng: rewrap script (first draft) — rewrap objects in-place by streaming through GCS and doing a key re-encrypt. pseudo: 

```
for obj in $(gsutil ls gs://partner-archive/backups/2026-03-23/*); do
  gsutil cp "$obj" - | rewrap-tool --from-key=wrap-key --to-key=new-key-v2 | gsutil cp - "$obj".rewrap
  gsutil mv "$obj".rewrap "$obj"
done
```

(note: we'll test on a single object first, not the whole prefix)

alex.sre: add monitoring: watch for Vault `wrap` 5xx or KMS 403 spikes. create a PagerDuty escalation if >5% of requests fail in 5m. i'll add that to the runbook.

maria.ops: permissions matrix — samira please create the key with only these IAM roles: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter for svc-rewrap and vault-sa; NO owners/editors. Also add bucket IAM restriction if feasible.

tim.sec: after rewrap we need to rotate any service account keys that had access (if any). i'll surface candidates from the logging output. if we see external principals, escalate to legal/comms.

oncall: I'll be the operator during the window. ping me 10m before start.

samira.eng: taking action items: creating key now, drafting rewrap canary script, will post key resource name when ready.

alex.sre: i'll prepare Vault change and a rollback (repoint back to old-key if needed).

maria.ops: assigning: samira = create key + run canary, alex = vault config + monitoring, tim = audit + principal list + escalate if external, oncall = run rewrap window. target: complete canary + audit by EOD. :thumbsup:

tim.sec: noted. I'll also run a quick scan for any plaintext leaks that could have contained unwrapped backups just in case.

security-bot: Incident updated: tasks assigned (samira, alex, tim, oncall). Next update due in 30m.

maria.ops: thanks team — post the exact commands/artifacts in thread as you run them so we have an audit trail.

alex.sre: will do. :white_check_mark:
